# ColorCraft

> ColorCraft (https://farger.borresendigital.no) is a free color tool for designers, made by Børresen Digital in Norway. It turns the colors from a brand guide (logo colors, surface colors, highlight colors) into a full screen palette with light and dark mode, checks contrast against WCAG 2.2, and makes a profile page the designer can send to a client. The tool runs in the browser without an account: palettes and profiles live in the URL fragment (after #), which is never sent to the server. Optional accounts add saved profiles, short links and an MCP server (see below).

The interface is Norwegian by default (`/`), with English at `/en`.

## Pages

- [Home](https://farger.borresendigital.no/): what ColorCraft is. English: https://farger.borresendigital.no/en
- [Tool](https://farger.borresendigital.no/verktoy): create and adjust palettes, read from the URL fragment. English: https://farger.borresendigital.no/en/verktoy. Old links on the home page (`/#p=…`) are forwarded to the tool.
- [Profile page](https://farger.borresendigital.no/profil): the color profile for a client, read from the URL fragment. English: https://farger.borresendigital.no/en/profil
- [Website view](https://farger.borresendigital.no/nettside): the palette on an example website, with a color bar to change the colors live. Same URL fragment as the profile page. English: https://farger.borresendigital.no/en/nettside
- [Profile file schema](https://farger.borresendigital.no/schema/colorcraft-profile-1.schema.json): JSON Schema for the profile file below.

## Recommended way for an AI to create a profile

Write a profile file (format `colorcraft-profile`, version 1) and let the designer import it in the tool: "Fra profilmanual" (From brand guide) → "Importer profil (JSON)". The designer reviews the colors before anything is created, and typography, usage rules, Pantone numbers and "made by" carry over to the profile page.

Building a link by hand is possible (see below), but a custom palette link needs all 14 screen colors for light mode, which ColorCraft normally computes from the brand colors. Prefer the profile file.

### Profile file (colorcraft-profile, version 1)

```json
{
  "format": "colorcraft-profile",
  "version": 1,
  "title": "Erling Olsen",
  "maker": "Honeybeedesign",
  "direction": "neutral",
  "colors": [
    { "role": "logo", "name": "Dark blue", "hex": "#002245", "cmyk": "100 80 30 40", "cmykSource": "manual", "pantone": "2945 C" },
    { "role": "support", "name": "Warm reed", "hex": "#C1B694" },
    { "role": "highlight", "name": "Fresh water", "hex": "#59A8BD" }
  ],
  "typography": [
    { "role": "Headings", "font": "Montserrat", "weight": 700, "size": "32–48 pt", "fallback": "Arial" }
  ],
  "rules": [
    { "role": "logo", "text": "Always on white or dark blue" },
    { "role": "general", "text": "Keep clear space around the logo" }
  ]
}
```

Rules for the file:

- `format` must be `"colorcraft-profile"` and `version` must be `1`. At most 200 kB.
- `colors[].role`: `logo` (1–3, the first is the main brand color), `support` (0–4, surface colors used as full backgrounds), `highlight` (0–2, small doses only: buttons, single words, never surfaces), `internal` (0–6, internal use only, for example presentations). Extra colors in a group are dropped. Duplicate and invalid colors are skipped. At least one color is required.
- `hex`: `#RRGGBB`. `name`: up to 60 characters.
- `cmyk`: four numbers 0–100 separated by spaces. Only kept when `cmykSource` is `"manual"` (numbers from the printed brand guide). Otherwise ColorCraft computes an approximate value itself.
- `pantone`: the number from the brand guide as text, for example `"2945 C"`. ColorCraft never converts to or from Pantone; the Pantone library is licensed.
- `direction`: `neutral`, `exclusive`, `sales`, `tonal` or `playful`. It only steers the generated colors around the brand; brand colors are never changed.
- `typography` (up to 4): `font` is required (letters, digits, spaces and `._-`), `weight` is 100–900, `size`, `fallback` and `note` are free text. Fonts are not downloaded; the profile page shows a sample if the font is installed.
- `rules[].role`: `logo`, `support`, `highlight`, `internal`, `main` or `general`. `text` up to 600 characters; one rule per line becomes a bulleted list.
- Unknown fields are ignored. Fields exported by the profile page but not needed for import: `group`, `tones`, `link`, `generator`.

## URL fragment format

Everything is in the fragment, as URL-encoded query parameters (`#a=1&b=2`).

Palette:

- `p=<id>`: a built-in palette. Ids: `sande`, `verdens-ende`, `ramnes`, `slottsfjellet`, `kaldnes`, `bokeskogen`, `larvikitt`, `lardal`, `borre`, `molen`, `ula`, `svenner`, `havet`, `solnedgang`, `skogen`.
- `m=dark`: show the dark variant.
- Custom palette: `v=1&n=<name>&l=<light>&d=<dark>`. `l` and `d` are 84 hex characters: 14 colors of 6 hex digits each, without `#`, in this order: primary, secondary, accent, warm, cool, background, surface, foreground, muted, border, success, warning, error, info. `d` is optional.
- Brand colors (with a custom palette): `bl`, `bs`, `bh`, `bi` (logo, support, highlight, internal; concatenated 6-digit hex), `br` (direction, if not neutral), `bn` (color names separated by `|`, in the order logo, support, highlight, internal), `bc` (manual CMYK as `c_m_y_k`, separated by `.`, same order).

Profile page only:

- `mk`: "made by", up to 60 characters.
- `ul`, `us`, `uh`, `ui`, `um`: usage rules for logo, support, highlight, internal and main colors. `ug`: general usage rules. Up to 600 characters each; line breaks allowed.
- `ty1` … `ty4`: typography as `role|font|weight|size|fallback|note`.
- `pn`: Pantone numbers as `RRGGBB~number`, separated by `|`.
- `lg`: the logo, compressed. Made by the profile page; do not create it.
- `ro=1`: the client's view, without the editing buttons. Add it to links meant for the client.

## Exports on the profile page

CSS variables, SCSS, Tailwind 4 (`@theme`), Figma variables (DTCG as Figma imports it), design tokens (DTCG with hex strings), SwiftUI, Flutter, Android `colors.xml`, and the profile file. Every brand color also gets a tone scale 50–950 in OKLCH with fixed lightness per step; the brand color itself is placed unchanged at the step with the closest lightness.

## Accounts and MCP

The tool works without an account. With an account (sign-in by email link or passkey, no passwords), a designer can save profiles and share them as short links (`/p/<slug>`), which always show the latest saved version.

An MCP server is available at `https://farger.borresendigital.no/mcp` (Streamable HTTP, JSON responses, no sessions). It needs a token the designer creates on the account page (`/konto`), sent as `Authorization: Bearer ccmcp_…`. Tools: `list_profiles`, `get_profile`, `create_profile` and `update_profile` (all using the profile file format above), `check_contrast` and `tone_scale`. Profiles cannot be deleted through MCP. A saved profile is visible to anyone with its short link, so give the designer the links to review it.

Accounts are switched on when the service is fully set up. Until then the MCP server answers 503 and the profile file is the way in.
